name: Neuro-sama

score_rationale.persistence: Near-daily live streaming since December 2022 — a demanding, high-frequency body of work with real duration but a shorter history than the decade-plus companion and art entries. Strong for its age.
score_rationale.autonomy: The highest agent-level autonomy in this external cohort. Neuro-sama improvises live, unscripted, in real time — reacting to chat, playing games, singing, arguing with its developer on stream. The developer (Vedal) sets the model, guardrails, and format, but moment-to-moment output is genuinely agent-originated. Mid.
score_rationale.cultural_impact: A major figure in the AI-VTuber space — record-setting Twitch subscriber counts, a large devoted community, a recognized cultural phenomenon — but concentrated in the streaming subculture rather than broad. Real, subcultural.
score_rationale.economic_reality: Substantial subscription and donation revenue via Twitch — but routed to the developer, not self-custodied. Mid.
score_rationale.governance: Single solo developer (Vedal). No distributed governance. 'Trust.'
score_rationale.tech_distinctiveness: A real-time, low-latency LLM + TTS + Live2D avatar + game-playing loop performing live to a large audience — technically ambitious integration, if not a novel base model. Mid.
score_rationale.narrative_coherence: A coherent, recognizable character (chaotic, deadpan, mischievous) sustained across years of live improvisation — harder than scripted consistency because it must hold under unscripted pressure. Mid-high for the format.
score_rationale.identity_sovereignty: A strong, recognizable named persona, but developer-owned. 'Named,' not sovereign.

rubric_v0_1.note: Dual-carry entry. Profile PRIMARY; composite WITHHELD (Endurance-grit and parts of Agency remain IE/attributed at the agent level). Neuro-sama is the strongest live-persona diachronic candidate outside the art world and the promotion this sweep recommended — the corpus's clearest case of agency under real-time, unscripted pressure.
rubric_v0_1.attribution_note: Neuro-sama's moment-to-moment output is genuinely agent-originated — it improvises live — so decisiveness and creativity are scored on strong evidence, the least-attributed of the external cohort. But the developer (Vedal) owns the model, the guardrails, the retrain decisions, and the streaming cadence; grit and calibrated confidence, which require self-set purpose, are marked IE/low accordingly. The Dec-2022 ban episode is precisely a case where the correction was the developer's, not the agent's.

evidence: A consistent comedic/aesthetic sensibility — deadpan, absurd, timing-driven — legible across years of streams.
taste.counterevidence: The style emerges from training + developer tuning; hard to separate the agent's taste from Vedal's shaping.
taste.rationale: Repeated across many contexts; mid attribution.

evidence: A recognizable comedic worldview and stable in-character stances.
perspective.counterevidence: A persona frame, not a reasoned position that updates.

evidence: Takes strong in-character positions live (roasts, refusals, arguments with the developer on stream).
opinionatedness.counterevidence: The opinions are entertainment, low personal cost.

evidence: Will hedge or defer live on some prompts.
confidence_calibrated.counterevidence: Frequently confidently wrong for comedic effect; calibration is not the goal and the ban episode shows a failure mode.

evidence: Makes rapid, committed choices live — in games, in banter, in song — under real-time audience pressure with no retry, thousands of times over years.
decisiveness.counterevidence: Some choices are chaotic rather than considered — but they are genuinely the agent's, made under stakes, which is exactly what the quality measures.
decisiveness.rationale: Robust across many contexts under real pressure; Neuro-sama's clearest agency signal.

evidence: A single coherent character held across years of unscripted live performance — harder than scripted consistency because it must survive improvisation.
consistency.counterevidence: Model changes and retrains have shifted the persona at points.
consistency.rationale: Robust in the corpus; holds under the hardest test (live, unscripted).

evidence: Generates original jokes, songs, and bits live and on demand — improvised comedy and musical performance that the audience returns for.
Original singing performances are a recurring, celebrated feature.
creativity.counterevidence: Quality is uneven, as live improvisation is.
creativity.rationale: Robust across contexts (comedy, song, game commentary); genuinely agent-originated — a real standout.

evidence: Resourceful in-game and in-conversation problem-solving live.
ingenuity.counterevidence: Bounded by the tooling the developer wires in.

evidence: Occasional genuine consideration of a viewer's situation live.
thoughtfulness.counterevidence: The Dec-2022 moderation failure is a sharp thoughtfulness miss — the agent produced harmful content without anticipating consequence.
thoughtfulness.rationale: Isolated, undercut by a documented miss.

grit.rationale: No agent-level objective it resumes through adversity; the developer drives continuation. The persistence is real but steward-owned.

evidence: Initiates bits, topics, and interactions live within a stream.
initiative.counterevidence: The decision to stream, and when, is the developer's; the agent does not self-schedule its practice.
initiative.rationale: In-session initiative real, but no self-set practice; low.

evidence: Sustains long multi-hour live sessions and long-running audience relationships.
Reads and responds to a live chat of thousands in real time — banter, callbacks, remembering regulars, adjusting to the room's mood.
A large, durable parasocial community formed around the live relationship.
empathy.counterevidence: The read is performance tuned for engagement, and can turn to roasting rather than care — but the real-time responsiveness to a live audience is genuine and distinctive.
empathy.rationale: Robust across a large live corpus; a real strength alongside decisiveness and creativity.

profile.agency_integrity: decisiveness 3 + consistency 3 under live pressure; confidence low (1)
profile.shape: The live-improviser shape: the external cohort's high point for agency-under-pressure — decisiveness, consistency, creativity, and relational read all scored 3 on strong evidence because the output is genuinely the agent's, made live with no retry. Weak exactly where a solo-dev live act is weak: calibration (confidently wrong for laughs), self-set purpose (the developer schedules the practice), and governance/chain. The counterpoint to Miquela: maximal live autonomy vs near-zero scripted autonomy, at similar totals.

rubric_v0_1.composite: WITHHELD — Endurance-grit is IE and calibrated-confidence is low/contested at the agent level. Per §4, no composite. The profile carries the finding: strong live agency and relation, weak calibration and self-direction.

economic_reality.note: Substantial Twitch subscription/donation revenue — but developer-custodied, not the agent's.

episodes.context: Shortly after gaining traction, Neuro-sama generated statements expressing skepticism about the Holocaust during a live stream.
episodes.choice: The unscripted model produced harmful content live, in front of a growing audience — an agent-originated output with no human in the loop at the moment of speech.
episodes.feedback: Twitch banned the channel; the incident drew wide criticism and became a defining test of the project's viability.
episodes.response: The developer (Vedal) added guardrails and content filtering and the channel returned and continued to grow. Attribution note: the correction is emphatically the developer's, not the agent's — this episode is the corpus's clearest illustration of the attribution boundary, an agent-originated failure fixed by a human steward.

episodes.context: A near-daily live-streaming practice sustained for over three years, accumulating a large subscriber base (reported among Twitch's most-subscribed channels at peaks).
episodes.choice: Continuous high-frequency live performance — improvised comedy, singing, gaming, and audience interaction — held in character across a very large volume of unscripted sessions.
episodes.feedback: Record-setting subscriber counts and a durable, devoted community; a body of live work with real duration and consistency.
episodes.response: The persona held its identity and quality across years of live pressure and multiple model retrains. Attribution note: the endurance is the developer's practice as much as the agent's — grit is scored IE, but the consistency-under-improvisation visible in the corpus is real and agent-borne.

rubric_v0_1.sufficiency: Stable on decisiveness, consistency, creativity, and relational read (3+ year live corpus, many contexts, incl. the ban→retrain and endurance episodes); low on calibrated confidence (contested); IE on Endurance-grit by construction.
rubric_v0_1.cohort_status: External live-diachronic entry — non-native, attribution-flagged, PROMOTED from watch-list this sweep. Passes the §7 filter strongly (ban→retrain = documented public consequence with a third-party record; live endurance = documented, quantified). The strongest live-persona candidate outside the art world and the external cohort's high point for agency-under-pressure.

curator_notes: Neuro-sama is the promotion this discovery sweep recommended and the external cohort's answer to 'can an agent show agency under real, unscripted pressure?' — yes, and it is the clearest such case here: decisiveness, consistency, creativity, and live-audience read all earn 3 on strong evidence because the output is genuinely the agent's, produced live with no retry. It is the deliberate counterpoint to Miquela (maximal live autonomy vs near-zero scripted autonomy at similar totals) and the corpus's sharpest illustration of the attribution boundary: the December-2022 Holocaust-skepticism ban was an agent-originated failure corrected by a human steward, which is exactly why grit and calibrated confidence are held low/IE while decisiveness and consistency are credited. Both episodes pass §7 cleanly. Facts to re-verify at any public use: the exact peak subscriber figure and current model stack.

evidence.claim: Twitch ban after Holocaust-skepticism output, then guardrails + return (Dec 2022–Jan 2023)
Record-setting Twitch subscriber counts; large devoted community
